pairs.why: A keeps a quiet tone-on-tone stripe backdrop with the clock floating on the wall like the real card, while B adds a floor ledge with a cast shadow that the real flat-field card doesn't have.
A keeps a plain gradient field with only a soft light beam, close to the real card's quiet backdrop, while B adds a long truss, heavier hardware and more rim detail.
Both show the same quiet moon environment with a few large shapes, craters and rocks, and neither is clearly busier than the real environment cards.
B's pi pattern is a bit larger, fewer and more tone-on-tone, closer to the real card's sparse pattern, while A's tighter, denser pi grid competes with the hero.
A has a simple door frame, a few large ivy shapes, and a small base ledge like the real card, while B adds a busier stone floor and wall texture.
A's softer, hazier skyline with a simpler railing is closer to the real card's quiet backdrop, though B is similar with only slightly more floor reflection and tile detail.
A has fewer, calmer wall planks and floor boards, close to the real card's simple wood corner, while B's grain looks a little busier.
A has sparse rocks and a quiet sand dune like the real card's few large quiet shapes, while B adds more small pebbles and a larger cast palm shadow.
